bible-1y.title: Bible in a year
bible-1y.desc: Every book, from Genesis to Revelation, about 3 chapters a day.

nt-90.title: New Testament in 90 days
nt-90.desc: The life of Jesus and the early church, 2 or 3 chapters a day.

gospels-30.title: Gospels in 30 days
gospels-30.desc: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, about 3 chapters a day.

psalms-proverbs-31.title: Psalms and Proverbs in 31 days
psalms-proverbs-31.desc: One chapter of Proverbs and a few psalms each day for a month.

john-21.title: John in 21 days
john-21.desc: One chapter a day from the Gospel of John. A good first step.

proverbs-31.title: Proverbs in 31 days
proverbs-31.desc: A chapter of wisdom for each day of the month.

psalms-30.title: Psalms in 30 days
psalms-30.desc: All 150 psalms, 5 a day, to pray and praise for a month.

paul-30.title: Paul's letters in 30 days
paul-30.desc: From Romans to Philemon, 2 or 3 chapters a day.

bible-2y.title: Bible in 2 years
bible-2y.desc: The whole Bible at a gentle pace, 1 or 2 chapters a day.

abraham.title: The story of Abraham
abraham.desc: The call, the promise and the faith of the father of many nations. Genesis 12 to 25.

joseph.title: The story of Joseph
joseph.desc: From dreams and betrayal to forgiveness in Egypt. Genesis 37 to 50.

moses.title: The story of Moses
moses.desc: From the basket on the river to Mount Nebo: the exodus, Sinai, the wilderness and farewell. Exodus, Numbers and Deuteronomy.

ruth.title: The story of Ruth
ruth.desc: Loyalty, care and a new beginning in Bethlehem. The book of Ruth.

samuel.title: The story of Samuel
samuel.desc: Hannah's prayer, the call in the temple, the prophet who anointed kings and his death. 1 Samuel 1 to 16, 19 and 25.

david.title: The story of David
david.desc: The shepherd who faced the giant, the king, the fall and repentance. From 1 Samuel 16 to 1 Kings 2.

elijah.title: The story of Elijah
elijah.desc: Fire on Mount Carmel, the gentle whisper and the chariot of fire. 1 and 2 Kings.

esther.title: The story of Esther
esther.desc: Courage in the palace to save her people. The book of Esther.

daniel.title: The story of Daniel
daniel.desc: Faithfulness in Babylon, the lions' den and the visions. The book of Daniel.

paul-story.title: The story of Paul
paul-story.desc: From the road to Damascus to chains in Rome. Acts 9, 11 and 13 to 28.

plans.support: Read it in another Bible? Mark it here. Everything you mark in the plan also counts in the Tracker.

about.title: About Selah
about.whatIs: Selah is a word found in the Psalms as an invitation to pause. This app exists to help you read the Bible calmly and consistently.
about.free: Free, no ads and no sign up. Your data stays on your device.
about.blivre: Bíblia Livre (BLIVRE), Copyright © Diego Santos, Mario Sérgio and Marco Teles. Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 Brazil license. Reproduction allowed with credit to the source and authors. Version distributed by eBible.org in December 2025. sites.google.com/site/biblialivre
about.bsb: The Holy Bible, Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Dedicated to the public domain. BereanBible.com
about.italics: In the Bíblia Livre, words in italics were added by the translators for clarity.

donate.title: Support Selah
donate.text: Selah is free and ad-free. If it helps you, consider supporting it with a donation via Pix. Pix is a Brazilian instant payment method.
donate.contact: Questions, suggestions or another way to help? Talk to us.

notification.title: Time to read
notification.generic: A moment with the Word today.

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.text: One notification a day, at the time you choose. On days you have already read, it will not come.
reminder.denied: Notifications are blocked for Selah. Allow them in your browser settings and try again.
reminder.failed: Could not turn it on right now. Try again.
reminder.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
reminder.iosInstall: On iPhone, add Selah to your Home Screen (Share > Add to Home Screen) and open it from there to turn on the reminder.
reminder.privacy: Daily reminder: the Selah server keeps only your device's notification address, the time, the time zone, the language and the dates of the last reminder sent and of your last reading (only the date, so no reminder is sent on a day you already read). It does not keep your name, email or what you read.
